name: posttooluse-skill-style
description: Remind skill/agent writing: token-level rules, ✅/❌ pairs
reason:
**[Skill/Agent Style]** You just edited a skill or agent definition. Check:
1. Rules specific to TOKEN level — not abstract principles
2. Every rule has ✅ positive + ❌ negative example pair
3. No explanatory text (reader is a model, not a human)
4. Use `<critical>` tag for hard constraints with checklist
5. Structured: tables > paragraphs, checklists > prose
6. Under 300 lines (200 preferred) — long skills get truncated
7. If rule can be enforced by hook → move to hook rule instead
